correctness.rationale: Orthogonal graph-Laplacian eigenspace decomposition into constants (eigenvalue0), between-part means (N), and each within-part sum-zero subspace (N-ni) yields explicit heat rows including singleton parts. For vertices in a common part i, row difference is ai(delta_x-delta_y), hence W1=2ai. For different parts i,j, signs and masses are explicit and a primal transport plan plus saturating edge-1-Lipschitz dual potential give W1=2max(Ui,Uj)-b, with b=e^-Nt, ai=e^-(N-ni)t, Ui=(1-1/ni)ai+b/ni. Edge maximization gives b+2(1-1/s)(e^-(N-s)t-b), s largest part. Derivative establishes threshold s-(N-s)<=2, sharp unique transient peak otherwise, limiting unattained universal supremum 2. Independently solved direct transport LPs for all pair types of K_{3,2,1,1} at t=0,.1,.4, matching formulas to <1e-9; finite examples supplement analytic all-real-time proof.
